s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Drive Shaft Dust Cover LH

s2.ptxt: Using SST, a steel plate and a press, install a new dust cover.

atten3.ptxt: Do not deform the dust cover.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Drive Shaft Inboard Joint Snap Ring LH
Install Rear Drive Shaft Inboard Joint Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Wrap protective tape around the splines of the outboard joint shaft assembly.
Install the following new parts to the outboard joint shaft assembly in this order.

s3.ptxt: Inboard joint boot clamp (A in illustration)
Inboard joint boot clamp No.2 (C in illustration)

s2.ptxt: Secure the drive shaft assembly in a vise between aluminum plates.
Align the matchmarks and install the tripod joint to the outboard joint shaft assembly.
Using a brass bar and hammer, tap in the tripod joint.

item.ptxt: Do not allow foreign matter to adhere to the tripod joint.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, install a new shaft snap ring.
Pack grease into the inboard joint assembly.
Align the matchmarks and install the inboard joint assembly to the outboard joint shaft assembly

s-1.ptxt: Install Drive Shaft Inboard Joint Boot

s2.ptxt: Install the inboard joint boot to the grooves of the inboard joint assembly and outboard joint shaft assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Do not allow grease to adhere to the fitting grooves of the boot.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Drive Shaft Outboard Joint Boot Clamp LH NO.2

s2.ptxt: Using needle-nose pliers, hook the projection and recess of the clamp together to secure it.

item.ptxt: Do not deform the claw of the hook portion.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Drive Shaft Inboard Joint Boot Clamp LH

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver, install the inboard joint boot clamp to the outboard joint boot.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Rear Drive Shaft Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Check that the joints operate smoothly with no excessive play when moved up and down, left and right, and in the axial direction.
Check that the joint boots are free of cracks, damage and grease leakage.

atten3.ptxt: Carry the drive shaft assembly in a horizontal position.
